ma.setNavigationBarColor(Object object)

Set the navigation bar color.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
frontColor String Yes Foreground color value, including the color of the button, title, and status bar. Only #ffffff and #000000 are supported.
backgroundColor String Yes Background color value. The valid value is a hexadecimal color code.
animation Object No Animation effect.
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Structure of object.animation

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
duration Number 0 No Animation change time, in ms.
timingFunc String 'linear' No Animation change mode.

Valid Values of object.animation.timingFunc

Value Description
'linear' An animation changes at a constant speed.
'easeIn' An animation starts at a low speed.
'easeOut' An animation ends at a low speed.
'easeInOut' An animation starts and ends at a low speed.

Sample Code

    ma.setNavigationBarColor({
      frontColor: '#ffffff',
      backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
      animation: {
        duration: 400,
        timingFunc: 'easeIn'
      }
    })
